decoder.mechanism: replace Euclidean nearest-center rounding with area-cumulative spherical two-means on L2 embeddings
decoder.decision: choose each split by ranking a cosine-score projection and cutting at the area-balanced cumulative quantile
decoder.prediction: bp-ng45 mean paired score rises and most of its seeds improve versus the parent while other case means stay within tolerance
decoder.falsifier: bp-ng45 mean paired delta is non-positive or any case mean falls more than 5 below the parent.

experiment.question: Can a decoder change of S raise bp-ng45 without losing its other designs?

target.rule: mean paired score delta over the case > 0 and most of its seeds improve

probes.note: the parent decoder calls reference_global_two_way; no comparison
